statement: A changelog line that names a planned record asserts the record exists. Four cejel 0.6.5 Unreleased lines (#479, #484, #487, #489) said 'the preregistered public-corpus delta has not run yet'. The 0.6.5 public-delta run then stopped before any preregistration was written (#491), so all four lines claimed a preregistration that did not exist, and none of them had been edited. Release prep replaced them with one sentence: the public before-and-after is recorded separately, and no result is cited. Rule: write the absence ('not run'), never a planned artifact's name. At release prep, list every record the Unreleased section names and confirm each one exists on main.
